result.reason: The redline adds Affiliate and contractor coverage and an M&A successor-assignment right, but it omits the required licence-duration protections: paid-up licences are not made perpetual and irrevocable, and subscription licences are not limited to termination for uncured material breach. The assignment drafting is also internally uncertain because the blanket voiding sentence does not expressly exclude permitted successor assignments, and the separate Change of Control provision may override the new M&A right. The disclosure provision is grammatically imprecise because it refers to Affiliates and contractors as “individuals.” The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the Field of Use and other unrelated restrictions.
